When Stryker is asked to perform a mission that Cyberforce won't touch, he puts together his own strike force to get the job done.

Stryker and his team practice in their new base. It is revealed that Bloodbow is actually the shapeshifting alien Shrrnnn who hasn't quite mastered Bloodbow's skills.

The team travels to the Himalayan mountains looking for an artifact for Joshua Thornewood. Meanwhile, Thornewood's brother also hires a mercenary team lead by Rancor Deathstrike to find the same artifact.

After a fight in the snow, Strykeforce is down and presumed dead.

Sh'rrrnn (still disguised as Bloodbow) shifts into an alien arachnid form to save the rest of the unconscious team. Meanwhile, Thornewood and his brother discover the pool of life which will prolong their life. However, it is guarded by a bigfoot type creature. Stryker and his team arrive in time to put Rancor's team down with the help of the mother yeti.

Stryker retrieves the elixer from the pool and gives it to Thornewood who double-crosses them and traps them in the cave. However, Stryker has the last laugh as it is shown that he replaced the elixer with elbow joint oil. Finally, the yeti helps Stryke Force escape from the cave.

Two years have passed since the events of the War of the Lance. 
 
Raistlin Majere meets with Crysania, a Cleric of Paladine who seeks to turn him from his path of darkness but finds herself attracted to him.  
  
Caramon is now a drunk who is kicked out of his house and sent to escort Crysania to Raistlin's Tower.  On their way, Crysania is attacked by Lord Soth a Death Knight on the orders of Kitiara, the Dark Lady. 
 
Raistlin then reveals his plans to Dalamar, his apprentice who is a Dark Elf.  He tells Dalamar that he knows of his mission as a spy for the Robes assembled at Wayreth.  Raistlin's plans of overthrowing the Dark Queen Takhisis has begun.

Previously, Raistlin Majere invites Crysania to his Tower in Shoikan Grove where he tells her of his plan to overthrow Takhisis. 
   
Present time, Crysania has been put into a deep sleep by Lord Soth a Death Knight, only by sending her to the past to Istar and the Kingpriest can she be healed. 
 
Caramon goes back with her also with the plan to stop Raistlin from entering the Portal.  Tasslehoff is accidently sent back with him.  Once in Istar, the two are captured and sent to the Arena. 
 
Crysania is healed and stays with the Kingpriest while Caramon plots to kill Fistandantilus.

The two Majere twins are forced to overcome impossible obstacles as Caramon goes toe-to-toe with the deadly Red Minotaur and Raistlin struggles against Crysania's assault on his heart, which may derail his quest and change his life forever.

The final spellbinding chapter of Time of the Twins.
